01/24/2005: Data Cleanup (jtb) 
 
            - For unknown reason, faulty precipitation data was added to  
              the MAWN database.   Precipitation data for the following 
              time periods were set to "0" and removed from database: 
 
                 12/22/2004 (23:30) - 12/23/2004 (04:35) 
 
                 01/22/2005 (14:00) - 01/22/2005 (17:30) 
 
 
12/14/2004: Telecommunication Troubles Corrected (sm): 
 
            - Modem and battery checked out to be fine. 
 
            - Replaced datalogger with a refurbished model.  Loaded 
              datalogger program, MAWN1E.   Data is now being collected 
              and modem accepts incoming phone calls used to download 
              the raw data file. 
 
            - Due to the malfunction of the faulty datalogger, data for 
              the following time periods are not available: 
 
                 11/29/2004 (01:20) - 12/01/2004 (09:40) 
                 12/01/2004 (22:45) - 12/14/2004 (10:35) 
 
 
12/03/2004: Communication Trouble (sm): 
 
            - Site visit to determine cause of recent telecommunication 
              trouble with the modem at the Munger MAWN station.  Appears 
              to be a telephone company problem.   Phone company will be 
              contacted. 
 
 
11/22/2004: Station Online: 
 
            - Data Collection and Data Archive for new station begins and 
              now made available via the MAWN website: 
 
                First data report:   Sat, Nov 20, 2004 - 00:05   (Day=325)
